column1: # Install-script carriers BELOW the population's download gate (ranks ~25,500-70,000) that the sweep
# does not cover, ordered by weight. Measured 2026-09-06.
# A carrier is a package whose releases that run an install script hold at least 1% of its downloads
# when summed. 286 of the 1,001 found run one only on a release that is not `latest`, so a scan that
# read `latest` alone could not see them. 18 of the 1,001 are already in the population, from its
# hand-curated half; the 983 below are what is left.
# 346 of 44,056 lookups did not resolve and are counted separately rather than folded into "no
# script", so this is a floor: a package's absence here is not evidence it never runs one.
# Supersedes two earlier cuts of this band, 720 read from `latest` alone and 678 under a top-3
# window. Neither is a subset of this one -- the first both over- and under-counted, and the second
# missed every package whose install-script releases are individually small but collectively not.
